findings.title: Header and footer tap targets below 44px
findings.detail: Measured on every device/orientation: brand link height 17px; English/Español language controls height 25px; Manifesto and Contact 15px. WCAG 2.2 target-size minimum is 24px; recommended mobile tap target remains 44px. Primary CTAs (Begin your Journey, Create account, Contact, Sign in) measured 48px and pass.

findings.title: Age-gate radios and consent checkboxes are 16×16 visual boxes
findings.detail: bh-age-eligible radios render at 16×16 and 14px computed font. Registration consent checkboxes are 16×16 with 16px font. Associated labels likely enlarge the hit area; Row 187 should confirm label wrapping on real iPhone/Android and enlarge if the label does not cover 44px.

findings.title: Inline Sign in text link is 18px tall
findings.detail: Register page 'Already have an account? Sign in' measured 18×204. Not launch-blocking; fix with Row 187 touch pass.

findings.title: Native Safari and physical devices were not available
findings.detail: Chromium 148 with iOS Safari / Chrome iOS / Chrome Android user-agents and current iPhone/Android CSS viewports. Apple Safari and WebKit were not installed on this runner. Physical iPhone 16 / SE and Galaxy / Pixel Chrome+Safari portrait/landscape remain required before treating this row as production-complete.
